_meta.description: Heart event #1 for npc_leera: The Race

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: Hey, Jack! Race you to The Hollow and back!

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: Loser buys drinks at the Gear. Ready?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [After the race — Leera wins by a hair]

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: I win! Barely! You're faster than you look, engineer.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: Most people won't even try to keep up with me.

lines.speaker: npc_leera
lines.text: You're alright, Jack. Drinks are on you tonight!
